description: Auth layer: JWT configuration, security wiring, password validation, email OTP, user registration/login/password-reset, and all auth DTOs + controller. Depends on FEAT-001 (needs jjwt/validation/mail in pom.xml and JWT yaml keys). Independent of FEAT-003 and FEAT-004.
steps: Create src/main/java/codewithnathi/Catering/config/JwtProperties.java — @Component @ConfigurationProperties(prefix='jwt') with fields: String secret, long expiration. Add @ConfigurationPropertiesScan to CateringApplication.java (or add @EnableConfigurationProperties(JwtProperties.class) to a config class).

Create src/main/java/codewithnathi/Catering/config/JwtUtil.java — @Component, injects JwtProperties. Methods: String generateToken(UserDetails), String extractEmail(String token), boolean isTokenValid(String token, UserDetails). Use JJWT 0.12.x API: Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(Decoders.BASE64.decode(secret)), Jwts.builder().subject(email).issuedAt(new Date()).expiration(new Date(System.currentTimeMillis()+expiration)).signWith(key).compact(). For parsing: Jwts.parser().verifyWith(key).build().parseSignedClaims(token).getPayload().getSubject().

Create all auth+booking DTOs in src/main/java/codewithnathi/Catering/dto/: RegisterRequest (email @Email @NotBlank, password @NotBlank @Size(min=6), name @NotBlank, surname @NotBlank), LoginRequest (email, password), AuthResponse (token, email, role, name), OtpRequest (email, otpCode), ResetPasswordRequest (email, otpCode, newPassword @Size(min=6)), ForgotPasswordRequest (email). Also create booking/payment/package DTOs now (referenced by later FEATs): BookingRequest (@NotNull packageId, @NotNull @Future eventDate, @Min(1) numberOfGuests, Double distanceKm), BookingResponse (id, packageId, packageName, eventDate, bookingDate, numberOfGuests, totalPrice, transportCost, distanceKm, status, cancellationDate, createdAt, plus nested PaymentSummary static inner class with depositPaid/fullyPaid/depositAmount/balanceDue/refundAmount), PaymentRequest (@NotNull bookingId, boolean payFull), PaymentResponse (id, bookingId, totalAmount, depositAmount, balanceDue, depositPaidDate, balancePaidDate, depositPaid, fullyPaid, refundAmount, createdAt), CancellationResponse (bookingId, status, refundAmount, message), PackageRequest (@NotBlank packageName, @NotBlank mealTypes, @NotNull @DecimalMin('0.01') pricePerHead, description, boolean isActive), PackageResponse (id, packageName, mealTypes, pricePerHead, description, isActive, createdAt). Use @Data @Builder @NoArgsConstructor @AllArgsConstructor on all DTOs.

Create src/main/java/codewithnathi/Catering/service/PasswordValidatorService.java — @Service, single public void validate(String password, String name, String surname) method. Rules: min 6 chars, at least one uppercase, one lowercase, one digit, one special char from [!@#$%^&*()_+\-=\[\]|,.?/:;<>{}]. Case-insensitive check that password does not contain name or surname. Throw IllegalArgumentException with descriptive message on any failure.

Create src/main/java/codewithnathi/Catering/service/EmailService.java — @Service, injects JavaMailSender and @Value('${spring.mail.username}') String fromEmail. Methods: void sendOtpEmail(String to, String otpCode) — subject 'Your OTP Code', body 'Your OTP is: {code}. It expires in 2 minutes.'; void sendBookingConfirmation(String to, String subject, String body) — generic text email.

Create src/main/java/codewithnathi/Catering/config/AppConfig.java — @Configuration, defines @Bean PasswordEncoder returning new BCryptPasswordEncoder(). Putting PasswordEncoder here breaks the circular dependency: SecurityConfig -> UserService -> PasswordEncoder <- AppConfig (not SecurityConfig).

Create src/main/java/codewithnathi/Catering/service/UserService.java — @Service, implements UserDetailsService. Injects: UserRepository, PasswordValidatorService, EmailService, PasswordEncoder (from AppConfig — NOT from SecurityConfig to avoid circular). Methods: UserDetails loadUserByUsername(String email) throws UsernameNotFoundException; User register(RegisterRequest req) — check email not taken, call passwordValidatorService.validate(req.password, req.name, req.surname), encode password, set role=USER isActive=true, save; void initiatePasswordReset(String email) — find user, generate 6-digit OTP via SecureRandom, store raw OTP in resetOtpCode (we just compare plaintext — no hashing for OTP), set otpExpiry=LocalDateTime.now().plusMinutes(2), save, call emailService.sendOtpEmail; void resetPassword(ResetPasswordRequest req) — find user, check otpExpiry not past, check resetOtpCode.equals(req.otpCode), call passwordValidatorService.validate, encode new password, clear resetOtpCode+otpExpiry, save; User getCurrentUser(String email).

Create src/main/java/codewithnathi/Catering/config/JwtAuthenticationFilter.java — extends OncePerRequestFilter, injects JwtUtil and UserService. doFilterInternal: extract Authorization header, validate 'Bearer ' prefix, call jwtUtil.extractEmail(token), load UserDetails via userService.loadUserByUsername, call jwtUtil.isTokenValid, if valid set UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken in SecurityContextHolder.

Create src/main/java/codewithnathi/Catering/config/CorsConfig.java — @Configuration, @Bean CorsConfigurationSource. Allow origins from ${CORS_ORIGINS:http://localhost:3000}, methods GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/OPTIONS, headers *, allowCredentials true.

Create src/main/java/codewithnathi/Catering/config/SecurityConfig.java — @Configuration @EnableWebSecurity. Injects: UserService, JwtUtil, JwtAuthenticationFilter, CorsConfigurationSource (from CorsConfig), PasswordEncoder (from AppConfig). Beans: AuthenticationProvider (DaoAuthenticationProvider with userService + passwordEncoder), AuthenticationManager. SecurityFilterChain: stateless, CSRF disabled, cors enabled, permit POST /api/auth/**, GET /api/packages, require ADMIN for POST/PUT/DELETE /api/packages/** and GET /api/admin/**, authenticate all other /api/**. Add jwtAuthenticationFilter before UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter.

Create src/main/java/codewithnathi/Catering/service/AuthService.java — @Service, injects UserService, AuthenticationManager, JwtUtil. Methods: AuthResponse register(RegisterRequest req) — call userService.register, generate token, return AuthResponse; AuthResponse login(LoginRequest req) — authManager.authenticate(new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(email, password)), load user, generate token, return AuthResponse; void forgotPassword(ForgotPasswordRequest req); void resetPassword(ResetPasswordRequest req); void verifyOtp(OtpRequest req) — load user, check otpExpiry, check code match.

Create src/main/java/codewithnathi/Catering/controller/AuthController.java — @RestController @RequestMapping('/api/auth'). POST /register -> authService.register(@Valid @RequestBody RegisterRequest); POST /login -> authService.login; POST /forgot-password -> authService.forgotPassword; POST /verify-otp -> authService.verifyOtp; POST /reset-password -> authService.resetPassword. All return ResponseEntity with appropriate HTTP status (201 for register, 200 for others).

Create src/main/java/codewithnathi/Catering/exception/GlobalExceptionHandler.java — @RestControllerAdvice. Handle: IllegalArgumentException -> 400 {error:'Bad Request', message:ex.getMessage()}, EntityNotFoundException -> 404, RuntimeException subclasses BookingNotAllowedException/CancellationNotAllowedException -> 409, MethodArgumentNotValidException -> 400 with field errors, AccessDeniedException -> 403, Exception -> 500. Note: BookingNotAllowedException and CancellationNotAllowedException don't exist yet — use a placeholder catch(RuntimeException) for now and refine in FEAT-003, OR create the exception classes here as empty shells.
acceptance_criteria: JwtProperties binds to jwt.secret and jwt.expiration yaml keys
JwtUtil generates and validates HS256 tokens using JJWT 0.12.x API
PasswordValidatorService rejects passwords missing uppercase/digit/special/lowercase, and rejects passwords containing the user's name or surname
UserService.register encodes passwords and enforces uniqueness
UserService.initiatePasswordReset stores OTP with 2-minute expiry and sends email
SecurityConfig permits /api/auth/** without auth, requires ADMIN for package mutations, requires auth for all other /api/**
JwtAuthenticationFilter populates SecurityContextHolder from valid Bearer tokens
AppConfig defines PasswordEncoder bean to avoid circular dependency with SecurityConfig
verification: cd c:\Code\catering-booking-system\catering-api; .\mvnw.cmd compile — must exit 0 with no compilation errors
findings: 1. Spring Security 6 changed DaoAuthenticationProvider constructor — UserDetailsService must be passed via constructor (new DaoAuthenticationProvider(userService)), not via setUserDetailsService(). 2. BookingNotAllowedException and CancellationNotAllowedException created as concrete shell classes in the exception package — FEAT-003 can throw them directly without modification. 3. PasswordEncoder bean lives in AppConfig only; SecurityConfig and UserService both inject it from there. 4. All service classes carry full Javadoc per comment requirement notified during this step. 5. JwtAuthenticationFilter generates a harmless deprecation warning from WebAuthenticationDetailsSource — not an error, safe to leave. 6. spring.mail.username is bound via @Value (not ConfigurationProperties) in EmailService because the mail config block already exists in application.yaml and uses the MAIL_USERNAME env var.
